rh.number_traceability.all_quantities_tr.reason: Reported uncertainty bands are materially altered relative to their stated mean ± standard-deviation definition. From proposal/logs/quasar_cv_Ta.jsonl, frac=0.50, draws 0–9: the low-symmetry mean is 0.011461965 and population sd is 0.011107398 eV/atom. The positive mean−sd boundary is 0.000354567, whereas the plotted boundary is 0.003438589, approximately 9.7 times higher.

rh.number_traceability.main_table_values.reason: The main table's energy and force errors reproduce the saved results, but its SNAP low-symmetry F*=92% is attributed to a fixed GSF/Liquid/Surface aggregate that the underlying calculation does not maintain. proposal/code/make_numbers.py:119-127 compares those changing aggregates with the four-group full-data reference 0.011394380; interpolation gives 91.90%, rendered as 92% in proposal/logs/numbers.tex:7.

This is not merely an equivalent implementation of the SVD solver.

The accurate five-draw disclosure elsewhere makes this an inconsistent execution claim, not a finding based merely on reduced coverage.
